from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from a single company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the document")
    filing_date: str | None = Field(description="End date of the reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM)")
    unit_consistency: str | None = Field(description="Whether all monetary values share the same unit (e.g. 'millions', 'thousands', 'mixed')")
    
    # Components for Return on Assets (ROA = Net Income / Total Assets)
    consolidated_net_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated Net Income amount")
    consolidated_net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Net Income (e.g. 'millions', 'thousands')")
    
    total_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets amount")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Total Assets (e.g. 'millions', 'thousands')")
    
    # Components for Quality of Earnings (OE = Operating Cash Flow / Net Income)
    operating_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net Cash Provided by/Used in Operating Activities amount")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Operating Cash Flow (e.g. 'millions', 'thousands')")
    
    # Components for Debt-to-Equity (D/E = Total Debt / Total Equity)
    total_debt_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total Debt amount (Short-term + Long-term)")
    total_debt_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Total Debt (e.g. 'millions', 'thousands')")
    
    total_equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total Stockholders' Equity amount")
    total_equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Total Equity (e.g. 'millions', 'thousands')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all company financials extracted from the document collection."""
    companies: list[CompanyFinancials]
